Nina (CS): Hi team — starting Lucid Edge onboarding thread. Goals: sandbox + SSO, first E2E integration in 14 days, and initial latency/cost dashboard by day 30. Who owns what?
Omar (CSM): Ill own stakeholder RACI and success criteria. Propose weekly 20-min sync Mon 9am PT.
Luca (Lucid Edge): Luca here. Primary constraints: we need peered sandbox and service account for KMS. Also want a short SRE enablement.
Tess (Solutions): I'll be tech lead. Need sample 2-min convo, expected QPS (burst/concurrency), and SSO metadata.
Sam (Security): I'll run compliance checklist. If audit retention >90d, flag for legal. Any PII expected?
Luca (Lucid Edge): No PII. SSO contact: idp@lucidedge.io. We'll upload payload + CIDR by EOD.
Nina (CS): Owners: Omar->comms & renewals watch; Tess->integration & perf; Sam->security sign-off; Nina->runbook and milestones.
Tess (Solutions): Minimal timeline suggestion:
Day 0: Kickoff + collect SSO/KMS/CIDR
Day 3: Sandbox provision + smoke auth
Day 7: E2E test + perf baseline
Day 14: Enablement + sign-off
Nina (CS): Risks: if security review >10 days then set renewal risk flag. Peering windows may add 48-72h.
onboard-bot: Meeting created: "Lucid Edge Onboarding Deep Dive" tomorrow 11:00am PT — invite sent.
Omar (CSM): I'll add CRM renewal checkpoints 60/30/14 and post calendar.
Nina (CS): Next steps: Luca uploads artifacts (EOD), Tess prepares test plan, Sam pre-reads questionnaire. Well reconvene after deep-dive and lock Week 1 tasks. :rocket:
